paite: Chiltang kitam ahihkeileh zahmoh atkhiak mi kuapeuh TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei.
heading: TOUPA Mite A Pan Posiahna

paite: TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah sawnta atel ding ahi kei. Suan sawm tan in asuante TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei hi.
Ammonte leh Moabte TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi kei. Suan sawmna tan in alak ua mi TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak a, atel mahmah louh ding uh ahi.
Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt lai ua tanghou leh tui a, ahon na dawn louh ziak un leh hon hamsiat dia Mesopotamia gam a Pethor a Beor tapa Balaam agoih ziak un.
Himahleh TOUPA na Pathian un Balaam thu angaikhe nuam kei; TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon it ziak in TOUPA na Pathian un huai hamsia nou a ding in vualzawlna asuaksak zaw hi.
Na damsung teng un akhamuanna ding uh leh alohchinna ding uh na ngaihtuahpih ding uh ahi kei.
Edom mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh lah ahi ngal ua. Aigupta mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, agam ua mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
Asuan uh thumna a pan TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi.
Na melmate uh dou dia giahphual na sat chiang un thilsiang lou chiteng a pan na kihuikhiak ding uh ahi.
heading: Sepaih Giahphual Kep Sianthouna

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh zan chiang a amah a pan chi apawt ziak a thanghuai na om uleh, giahphual a pan apawt dia, giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi kei.
Himahleh ni ahong kai chiang in, akisil dia; nitum chiang in giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi.
Giahphual polam ah zun leh ek thakna ding mun na sep ding uh ahi.
Na vanzat lak uah ninluahna na nei ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, na dailen chiang un, huai in lei na khuak ding ua, zun leh ek na thak uh na vuk nawn ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un lah na giahphual uah nou hon humbit ding leh na melmate uh hon pe ding in ahong tel ngal a. Huaiziak in na giahphual uh asiangthou ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thilsiang lou amu dia, hon paimangsan ding hi.
Na kiang ua sikha, apu hon taikhiaksan na pekik nawn ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Dan Tuamtuam

paite: Na omna ua adeihpen atel peuhpeuh ah na lak uah a-om sam ding ahi. Amah na nuaisiah ding uh ahi kei.
Israel tanute lak ah kizuak a-om ding ahi kei a, Israel tapate lak ah leng pasal kizuak a-om ding ahi kei.
Kizuakna man hiam, toko man hiam thuchiamna ding in TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na tawi ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
Apung delh in na unau na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Dangka lam a pung hiam, nek ding lam a pung hiam, bangpeuh apung delh a leitawisak louh ding ahi.

Gamdang mite bel apung delh in na leitawisak thei ding uh. Himahleh na unaute apung delh in na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Huchi in na va luah ding uh gam a na khut ngakna tengteng uah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a thu na chiam un sawt hal lou in na pe pah ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un lah hon phut ngei ding ahi ngal a. Khial in na moh kha ding hi.
Thuchiam lam a na kidek uleh nou a ding in khelhna ahi kei ding.
Na kam ua pawtsa na hih ding uh ahi: Ut thu a thillat na kam ua na chiam uh TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na chiam bang ua na lat pah ding uh ahi.
Na invengte grephuan a na hoh chiang un na deih zah uh na ne ding ua, himahleh na seng ua na guan louh ding uh ahi.
Na invengte buh ding lai mun a na hoh chiang un avui na khiak thei ding uh. Himahleh na invengte buh ding lai ah kawite na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
